reason: Touches a central executor path (`sort`/`topn`) in 7 runtime files, specifically kill-signal handling across spill and parallel-sort code. That combination is high-risk for executor correctness: unkillable/hung queries, cancellation races, leaked goroutines/temp spill files, or wrong shutdown behavior under memory pressure. Even though scoped to `sortexec`, the operators are common enough and the concurrency/spill surface is tricky enough to justify a focused Blocker/High review.
